verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official `pplx` CLI that returns structured JSON from the Search API. It is built for shell pipelines, interactive terminal work, and coding agents, and it can extract query-relevant passages from a page. A probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, evidence that it covers more than search (e.g., the Agent API, Sonar answers, or Computer tasks), and documentation of install, auth, and commands beyond the overview.
